verdict.rationale: Phaser (as a framework, not an agent) offers an official hosted MCP server ('Phaser Game Agent MCP server') documented at phaser.io/agent/mcp, explicitly stating it integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other MCP-compatible agents via 40+ specialised tools, and this is corroborated by a runtime probe confirming the hosted endpoint. missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of actually connecting an agent to it, and no distributable npm package (hosted-only, non-browser access 403s complicate discovery).
